source.title: Regulations Committee Digest - Q1 2025
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Regulations Committee (WRC) has been hard at work over the past few months, and we have some updates to share with you!

<!-- break -->

**General Updates**

* In January, the [team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/teams-committees-councils#wrc) onboarded 10 new members, who have all been a huge help in continuing our operations. Congratulations to those members!
* We would like to recognize Jonas Balsfulland (Delegate Reports subteam leader) and Oliver Hexter (Regulations Development subteam leader), who have recently been promoted to Senior Member!
* 3 new [Translations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/) have been added since the most recent Regulations update. If you would like to assist in translating the WCA Regulations, please contact us!


**Incidents Resolved in Q1**

The WRC resolved incidents from over 100 competitions in Q1! A summary from some of the most notable incidents can be seen below, a few of which describe applications of Regulations in the most recent Regulations update:

[Al-Madar Open 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/153) - Competitor likely received a misscramble on a National Record attempt

[Franconia Spring 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/155) - Competitor thought timer malfunctioned after getting second DNF for timer start

[German Newcomer Day 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/157) - Missing signatures from the judge and competitor, video evidence was available but the judge could not be located

[NxNationwide Lewis Center 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/149) - Competitor checked if camera was on during inspection

[Pampulha Open 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/152) - Judge did not reset timer and recorded the previous competitor's time

[PBQtah 7 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/148) - Competitor got a DNF result on a timer that was not reset

[PUCP Cubing Festival IV 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/150) - Competitor stopped timer with potential karate chop

[Rzeszow Open 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/158) - Competitor entered the scramble area after scrambling started, but before his first solve

[SacQuiet Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/156) - Competitor started a Multiblind attempt without a judge present

[Santa Barbara Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/154) - Competitor realized the color scheme on their puzzle was swapped during their solve

If you have any questions about the application of the Regulations, please reach out to us at [regulations@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:regulations@worldcubeassociation.org)

translation.title: WCA 规则委员会工作简报：2025 年第一季度
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

过去几个月，WCA 规则委员会（WRC）开展了不少工作，现向大家介绍近期进展。

<!-- break -->

**日常工作**

* 1 月，[团队](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/teams-committees-councils#wrc)迎来了 10 名新成员，他们为各项工作的持续开展提供了很大帮助。祝贺各位！
* 代表报告小组负责人 Jonas Balsfulland 和规则制定小组负责人 Oliver Hexter 近期晋升为高级成员，在此向他们表示祝贺！
* 自最近一次规则更新以来，我们新增了 3 种[规则译本](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/)。如愿意协助翻译 WCA 竞赛规则，欢迎联系我们！

**第一季度处理的事件**

WRC 在第一季度处理了来自 100 多场比赛的事件。以下是部分较值得关注的案例，其中一些涉及最新版规则的实际应用：

[Al-Madar Open 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/153)——选手在一次国家纪录成绩的还原中，很可能拿到了错误打乱。

[Franconia Spring 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/155)——选手第二次因启动计时器的问题被判 DNF 后，认为计时器出现故障。

[German Newcomer Day 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/157)——成绩单缺少裁判和选手签名；虽有视频证据，但无法找到当时的裁判。

[NxNationwide Lewis Center 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/149)——选手在观察期间检查摄像机是否开启。

[Pampulha Open 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/152)——裁判未将计时器归零，并记下了上一位选手的用时。

[PBQtah 7 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/148)——选手使用未归零的计时器完成一次还原，成绩被判 DNF。

[PUCP Cubing Festival IV 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/150)——选手停止计时器时可能使用了手刀动作。

[Rzeszow Open 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/158)——打乱工作开始后、本人第一次还原前，选手进入了打乱区。

[SacQuiet Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/156)——选手在没有裁判在场的情况下开始多盲尝试。

[Santa Barbara Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/154)——选手在还原过程中发现魔方的配色被调换。

如对规则的应用有任何疑问，请联系 [regulations@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:regulations@worldcubeassociation.org)。
